purpose: Real bytes of this project's RETIRED proof-batch wire, kept as foreign-object refusal cases for the range-claim decoder. They are not a version gate: the range claim is pure ABI with no magic and no length prefix, so these are simply a different kind of object. The case is live rather than historical because the claim-follower decodes the calldata of every transaction addressed to the ClaimRegistry, and anyone can address one there. The only acceptable outcome is refusal — never a partial decode that yields plausible-looking hashes read out of an unrelated structure.
wireFormat: magic "KCPB" (4) | version (1) | pv_len uint32 BE (4) | abi.encode(ProofBatch) | proof_len uint32 BE (4) | proof

cases.provenance: Byte-for-byte copy of op-supernode/proofbatch/testdata/proof-batch/single-block-no-logs.bin from karl/silhouette-v1 @ 92973bd060. Its keccak matches the envelopeKeccak that fixture's own JSON sidecar pins, which is what proves the copy is exact.
cases.note: A frozen corpus fixture, so these are the bytes a live v3 producer really emitted — not a valid encoding with the version byte poked.

cases.provenance: No stored v4 corpus exists on karl/silhouette-v1 (its testdata tree stops at v3), so these bytes were produced BY THAT BRANCH'S OWN CODEC at 92973bd060 — proofbatch.EncodeAs(batch, nil, proofbatch.Version) with proofbatch.Version == 4 — and round-tripped through proofbatch.DecodeAs before capture. The scratch generator was deleted afterwards and the harvest worktree left clean.
